source.title: Turn of the Month Effect in Futures Momentum Strategy

summary: Strategy using 52 liquid futures with 100-day SMA momentum signal, positions held only during the 3-day TOM window. Over half of total momentum returns occur in the TOM window, delivering higher risk-adjusted performance. Direct precedent for H205 design (TOM overlay on BAB stock positions).
actionable: Use as design validation for H205. The futures result suggests TOM concentration of alpha is not just a data artifact — momentum/low-vol alpha concentrates around month-turn across asset classes. Consider extending H205 to test 3-day vs 4-day TOM window (we currently use last 2 + first 2).
